description: Header file defining color and text style enums, structs, and formatting utilities for color support in the fmt library.

classes.name: text_style
classes.description: Represents text styling with foreground/background colors and emphasis.

classes.name: detail::color_type
classes.description: Union type for RGB or terminal color.

classes.name: detail::ansi_color_escape
classes.description: Generates ANSI escape sequences for colors and styles.

classes.name: detail::styled_arg
classes.description: Wraps a value with a text style for styled formatting.

methods.name: fg
methods.description: Creates a text_style with foreground color.

methods.name: bg
methods.description: Creates a text_style with background color.

methods.name: styled
methods.description: Returns a styled argument for formatted output.
